scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,rust -c cyan,green "vite" "cargo run --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p imail-http --bin imail-server -- --http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787"
scripts.build:remote: npm run build:web && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p imail-http --bin imail-server && cargo build --release --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p imail-storage-sqlite --bin imail-maintenance
scripts.test:internal-release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run rust:test && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && npm audit --omit=dev && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop:internal && npm run test:desktop-release
scripts.backup: cargo run --release --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p imail-storage-sqlite --bin imail-maintenance -- backup
scripts.restore:prepare: cargo run --release --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p imail-storage-sqlite --bin imail-maintenance -- restore
scripts.upgrade:preflight: cargo run --release --locked --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p imail-storage-sqlite --bin imail-maintenance -- upgrade-preflight
